purpose: Follow-up search for AHF-specific exterior imagery, elevations, and plans before considering facade geometry changes.

findings.source: Purdue ECN Engineering Webcams, Purdue Large Animal Hospital camera page
findings.finding: The official camera is described as viewing the Purdue Large Animal Hospital complex from the roof of Wade Power Plant. The page and frame do not identify Animal Holding Facility as the subject or provide an AHF-specific facade view; it is not used to infer AHF elevations, openings, or entrance location.

findings.source: Indiana State Budget Committee meeting minutes, June 2000, Purdue Animal Holding Facility Phase III cost increase
findings.provider: State of Indiana State Budget Agency
findings.finding: The indexed minutes say Phase III added to and renovated the existing facility, with an increased total project cost. This corroborates project phasing only and provides no facade design or elevation measurements.

The public landing page describes a bid-document portal but yielded no publicly indexed AHF-specific exterior drawings or facade image in this search. No building detail is inferred from the portal landing page.

findings.source: Purdue Campus Facilities and Buildings Historic Database, AHF record
findings.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
findings.finding: The record confirms three construction phases and Phase III addition/renovation, but the main image field is null and the phases have no attached image records.

decision: No new AHF-specific visual or measured facade evidence was found. No facade, entrance, window, material, or height geometry was added from generic institutional context. Existing neutral facade remains explicitly unverified.
limitations: This is an indexed public-web search, not an exhaustive search of physical, restricted, or uncatalogued archival collections. Purdue Archives identifies source material for consultation and recommends contacting archives@purdue.edu for further information.
